introBibleVerse: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it. (John 1:5)
introText: Light of the World is a young, vibrant Christian church whose members come from a range of nationalities, cultures and Christian traditions. We help those exploring faith become committed followers of Jesus Christ and support believers as they grow in fellowship with one another and in a living relationship with him.
goal1: Helping Farsi speakers in the Netherlands and abroad learn about the Christian faith and take part in church life.
goal2: Supporting believers as they grow in their personal relationship with Jesus Christ.
goal3: Offering spiritual, educational and social activities for children, young people and adults.
goal4: Helping people with practical challenges in daily life, including support for refugees and asylum seekers.
goal5: Sharing the gospel through events, media and personal conversations.
activity1: Services: Weekly worship services in Almere and online, with clear biblical teaching and opportunities for fellowship.
activity2: Children’s programmes: Helping children follow Jesus and grow in faith in a loving environment.
activity3: Small groups: Meeting during the week to get to know Jesus better and follow him in daily life.
activity4: Courses: Practical Bible study courses to deepen our understanding of God’s Word.
activity5: Support for refugees and asylum seekers: Helping Farsi speakers in the Netherlands take part in society, with guidance on culture, integration and naturalisation.
finance1: The church is funded through gifts, voluntary contributions and other lawful sources.
finance2: Funds are used solely to further the church’s purposes.
finance3: The church provides an annual financial report and maintains transparent accounts in accordance with ANBI guidelines.
futureText: The policy plan is reviewed annually and updated as needed. The church seeks to develop its spiritual and social ministry sustainably, helping Farsi speakers experience how knowing and following God can transform their lives.
footerText: God is enthroned on the praises of his people.

ourVisionText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
unityPrayerWorshipIntro: Our vision is to lead Farsi speakers in the Netherlands towards salvation, healing, freedom and a victorious life in Christ, and to play our part in the fulfilment of the prophecy in Jeremiah 49. We believe God has a special plan for the Iranian people and is shining his light upon them today, both in the Netherlands and around the world.
godThroneText: We are an evangelical church seeking to build on what God has done in the Netherlands through vibrant churches filled with the Holy Spirit. Our services include music, singing and active participation by the pastor and congregation, with space for joy, prayer and open worship. We stand when the Gospel is read, out of reverence for God’s Word. We especially serve Farsi-speaking believers in the Netherlands so they can freely hear God’s Word, grow in faith and discover their calling.
godsThroneAmongPeopleText:
Our values shape who we are and guide us as we pursue our vision and mission:

• Personal conversion and faith: nurturing a living relationship with Jesus Christ.
• Social responsibility: caring for one another and serving society.
• Commitment to family: valuing the role of the family and strengthening its unity.

“He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers.” — Malachi 4:6
godsTempleText: Our statement of faith summarises our core beliefs as a community of followers of Christ, rather than covering every aspect of faith and life. We believe in the power of the gospel, the guidance of the Holy Spirit and the church’s calling to be the light of the world.
ourMissionText: Inspired by the gospel of Jesus Christ, we come together and grow in a community of love, hope and service to one another. We warmly invite you to join us as we seek to be a blessing to the wider community.
firstService: Our faith grows as we come together.
firstServiceText: We put our faith, hope and love into practice by helping those in need, fighting poverty and supporting refugees.
firstServiceImageAlt: Faith and fellowship in the church
secondService: Rooted in the past, looking to the future.
secondServiceText: We preserve the church’s valued traditions while welcoming fresh, creative ways to share in fellowship and worship, responding to the needs of today and tomorrow.
thirdService: God’s love inspires us to serve.
thirdServiceText: We support one another with love, compassion and hope. Motivated by God’s love and welcoming everyone, we do all we can to be a blessing to our city and community.
thirdServiceImageAlt: A sunlit cross seen through the entrance of a cave
aboutUsSectionText: The leadership team at Light of the World Church consists of caring, dedicated pastors and ministry workers. Through prayer and spiritual guidance, they support members as they grow in faith and serve others. Our goal is to create a warm, encouraging environment where everyone can deepen their relationship with God and bear fruit in life and ministry.
aboutUsTitle: Let your light shine before others, so they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
KazemTeamRole: Pastor of Light of the World Church
KazemFaithJourney: My journey of faith began in Turkey in 1990, when I came to know Jesus Christ through the ministry of Pastor Corley.
KazemFormation: From 2000 to 2002, I received biblical teaching at Immanuel Church in the Netherlands, where I was also baptized. I later joined the Iranian Church 222 in the Netherlands, where I grew in faith and began serving in ministry.
KazemMinistry: In 2022, guided by the Holy Spirit, we founded Light of the World Church in Almere. Our goal is to be a light in the darkness and share the gospel of salvation with Farsi speakers and other residents of Almere and the Netherlands, as well as our fellow Iranians in Iran and around the world.
KazemMission: Relying on the love of our Heavenly Father and the power of the Holy Spirit, we seek wholeheartedly to follow Jesus' command in Matthew 28:19–20 by making disciples, baptizing them, and teaching them God's Word. We also seek to carry out this mission in unity and cooperation with other churches so that, as Jesus prayed in John 17, the world may see that we are one in Him.
KazemFamilyMinistry: Today I serve as pastor of Light of the World Church, and my wife, Fariba, serves God alongside me.
HamidTeamRole: Assistant pastor of Light of the World Church
HamidFaithJourney: My journey of faith began in June 2012, when I had no belief in God or religion. After receiving a Bible from a family member, I began reading it with the intention of disproving the Gospel. But as I read the Gospel of John, the love of Jesus Christ touched my heart.
HamidCommitment: One night, while reading John 3:16, I had a profound experience of the Lord’s presence and entrusted my life to Jesus Christ.
HamidBaptism: I was baptized in water in October 2012 and experienced baptism in the Holy Spirit in 2013.
HamidMinistry: Today I serve as assistant pastor of Light of the World Church alongside my wife Sima, who is the church's worship leader. My heart's desire is for others to know the love of the Lord and grow in faith and in a personal relationship with Jesus Christ.
